name: codex-subagent-router
description: Quality-first Codex subagent routing for selecting VoltAgent and Agency identities, skills, models, and staged delegation plans.

interface.shortDescription: 自动选择 Codex 子代理、skills、模型和执行阶段。
interface.longDescription: Codex Subagent Router packages a local quality-first routing system as a personal Codex plugin. It helps the parent Codex choose the right VoltAgent or Agency agent identity, runtime role, sandbox, skills, model strength, execution adapter, execution stages, fallback behavior, and managed next action for explicit subagent requests. Agency prompt-pack specialists from msitarzewski/agency-agents are bundled as a provider layer with compact agent-card indexing, context ledger reporting, and budgeted prompt hydration so normal delegation stays lightweight.
defaultPrompt: 开启子代理，调用合适 agent 完成任务
用多代理审查并优化当前项目
解释这次应该使用哪些 agents 和 skills
